title: Work, desired rate and urgency are independent
summary: Outbound scheduling must keep amount of work, desired execution rate and business urgency separate so that bulk work can be polite without falsifying accounting.
invariants: Expected work is represented in WLU and is not changed to manufacture priority.
Desired execution speed is represented as WLU/second or equivalent delivery capacity.
Business urgency is represented by traffic class and bounded priority.
Bulk source ingestion, legal/news collection and background research may be intentionally slower than interactive or time-sensitive work.
Hard route/security/legal constraints are evaluated before any priority or fitness ranking.
Rate limiting and burst control are part of being a good remote-service citizen, not merely local optimisation.

provenance.claim: Hard eligibility precedes optimisation and WLU remains separate admission authority.
Observation proves WLU delivery throttling can be separate from semantic state and scheduling authority.
